subject: Licensed test-basket onboarding & recall timeline
messages:
From: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@retailco.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: RetailCo Legal <legal@retailco.com>
Date: 2028-04-11 09:12 PDT
Subject: Request: licensed test-basket onboarding + usage constraints

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the throughput numbers look promising. We are starting the internal approvals for a short evaluation window (6 weeks) and would like to exchange a small licensed test basket (approx 1,200 labelled test cases + prompt variants) under a Mutual Action Plan. Key asks from our side:

- A MAP with clear delivery milestones and acceptance gate (we need a deterministic takedown date).
- Explicit usage constraints: no redistribution, ephemeral ephemeral sandbox only, and retention limited to 30 days post-evaluation.
- A security manifest and a secure transfer method (SFTP or signed presigned URL) + contact for ingestion support.

Can you share a draft MAP and onboarding checklist we can circulate with Legal? We are aiming to start data transfer the week of Apr 18 and complete acceptance by May 30.

Best,
Maria
Maria Gomez
Senior Product Manager, RetailCo
[Attachment: sample-data-sample-list.csv (csv)]

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@retailco.com>
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: 2028-04-11 10:05 PDT
Subject: Re: Request: licensed test-basket onboarding + usage constraints

Hi Maria — great to hear and thank you for the clear asks.

We can support the requested constraints. High level proposal:

1) MAP milestones
   - Week 0 (sign MPA): Redwood provides Licensed Test Basket manifest + SFTP creds
   - Week 1 (ingest): RetailCo ingests into their sandbox provided by Redwood; Redwood runs smoke validation
   - Weeks 2–5 (eval): RetailCo runs evaluation queries; weekly syncs
   - Week 6 (acceptance): Acceptance criteria runbook executed; either accept or provide regression artifacts
   - Day 30 after acceptance: Redwood triggers automated data expiry (per manifest)

2) Usage constraints (we will mirror as contract clauses)
   - No external redistribution beyond named RetailCo evaluators
   - Data retention cap: 30 days after acceptance; logs retained 90 days for audit only
   - Ephemeral sandbox: no export from sandbox except aggregated metrics

3) Transfer & security
   - We will send SFTP endpoint + short-lived credentials in a separate secure message; transfer will be over SFTP with checksums
   - Attachments: Redwood_MAP_v1.pdf (draft MAP), licensed-test-basket-manifest.csv, SFTP-onboard-instructions.txt

I attached a draft MAP and the manifest for the items we propose to transfer. Can Lauren and Ben help with the technical handoff and SSO/SFTP details?

If the timeline (start week of Apr 18) works, I can send a DocuSign-ready MAP by Apr 14.

Thanks — talk soon.

—Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Sr. Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_MAP_v1.pdf (pdf)]

From: lauren.bishop@redwood.com <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@retailco.com>, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: 2028-04-12 08:47 PDT
Subject: Re: Request: licensed test-basket onboarding + usage constraints

Thanks Tessa / Maria. Operational notes from our side:

- Ingest method: we can push an initial manifest to SFTP or provide a GCS presigned package — given Legal prefers strict controls, SFTP is better.
- Sandbox: we will provision an ephemeral tenant scoped to RetailCo with token-level telemetry and a KV-prefix cache reset after expiry.
- Acceptance runbook (summary):
   * 20 random seeds from the basket run through three eval prompts (pass threshold: >=88% F1 on labelled set for primary intent).
   * If the run fails, RetailCo provides counterexamples and Redwood has a 5-business-day remediation window.
- Retention automation: we will tag assets and run lifecycle delete at T+30 days post-acceptance; audit trail exported to S3 (read-only) for 90 days.

Ben — please prepare the SFTP creds and a short checklist for RetailCo engineers. Maria — once you confirm the Roadmap milestone dates, we'll prep DocuSign.

- Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Product Ops, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: acceptance-runbook-summary.md (md)]

Thanks — Ben
